primary_metric: exact endpoint P_opt; P_valid separately; no postselection/bit repair
comparison: exact training only; single 200; multistart anchor100+random100; INTERP p1:100+p2:100; same total cap, actual nfev reported
scope: one fixed previously observed reference; initialization study, no generalization or matched-time claims
historical_note: fresh controls; no trained angles or old results imported from Notebook22
interp_rule: Zhou et al. PRX 10 021067 (2020), Appendix B Eq B1; p1 -> p2 repeats beta and gamma
winner_rule: lowest returned exact normalized mean energy among completed target-depth trials; deterministic tie by plan order
